notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with enough additional mana to cast it.
description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Stormsplitter triggers, creating a token copy of Stormsplitter.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {3}, tapping two copies of Stormsplitter, and tapping Caetus.
Both Stormsplitters triggers, creating two token copies of themselves.
Reiterate resolves, copying the spell from step 1 and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4} and tapping two token copies of Stormsplitter.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Reiterate resolves, copying the spell from step 1 and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {2} and tapping four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Reiterate resolves, copying the spell from step 1 and returning itself to your hand.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by tapping six token copies of Stormsplitter.
Repeat from step 10.
